name: CYCLISTS_RACE_IN_PROGRESS_YELLOW_SQUARE

nsw_t4-213-1n_racing_cyclist.desc: racing cyclist, about 302 x 250 (symbol detail on a 25 mm grid); traced from the left one of the pair

notes: TfNSW plan T4-213-1n (Roads & Maritime 2019 sheet, 1:10, text outlined): 1000 x 1000, square corners, black border 25 ('25' corner mark), yellow ground. Vertical chain 90 / 120 / 70 / 250 (symbols) / 70 / 120 / 90 / 100 / 90: CYCLISTS 120 D (143 / 713 / 144), RACE 120 D (304 / 391 / 305), IN PROGRESS 100 D (88 / 108 / 66 / 650 / 88). Two racing cyclists 250 high; their horizontal positions are not dimensioned and were measured on the sheet (ink 118-420 and 582-884), the left one traced and used for both.
